bb.name: Gruve
bb.description: A gruvbox theme for coding: sharp corners, flat surfaces, a monospace UI and a composer styled as a terminal prompt, with settings for the accent colour, fonts, text size, corners and prompt. Dark mode is gruvbox soft; light mode puts gruvbox ink on neutral paper instead of yellow.

themes.name: Gruve
themes.description: Gruvbox soft dark (#32302f) and a neutral paper light (#f4f1e8), with 0px corners and a JetBrains Mono UI.
